scope: db.ktra multi-domain canonical ownership; no production behavior or migration is implemented by this artifact

facts.business_meaning: Initial result of the actual inspection, not dossier/application assessment.
facts.api_contract: Extend PUT /cases/{case_id}/outcome only; expected_version is required for an existing outcome.
compatibility_fields: CaseAssessment.assessment_result is not a compatibility target for this source.
facts.migration_source: Direct only when row identity and source value are deterministic.
invariants: Must never write CaseAssessment.assessment_result from db.ktra.Kết quả.
Does not imply final CAPA evaluation.
unresolved_cases: Existing assessment rows populated by the old importer are BLOCKED_EXISTING_CANONICAL_CONFLICT until read-only reconciliation.
facts.deprecation_plan: Stop importer writes to CaseAssessment.assessment_result from this source; retain existing values as read-only historical data pending reconciliation.

facts.api_contract: PUT /cases/{case_id}/assessment; the source-specific importer may write only from a proven assessment field.
facts.migration_source: BLOCKED_PARSE until the proper legacy source is independently mapped.
invariants: db.ktra.Kết quả is forbidden input.
unresolved_cases: The correct historical dossier-assessment source has not been established in this contract.

facts.business_meaning: Final conclusion after CAPA, separate from the initial actual-inspection result.
facts.api_contract: Proposed explicit POST /cases/{case_id}/outcome/finalize with expected_version; not writable through the generic initial-outcome update.
facts.migration_source: SAFE_DIRECT only when identity is deterministic; otherwise MANUAL_REVIEW.
invariants: Must be distinct from outcome_result.
Runtime finalization requires the applicable CAPA cycles to be terminal under the existing workflow contract.
No automatic state transition follows from storing the value.
unresolved_cases: Whether historic CAPA evidence proves finalization is a reconciliation question, not a runtime inference.

facts.business_meaning: Composite inspection decision reference/number and decision date.
facts.semantic_type: nullable string plus nullable date, with raw composite evidence
facts.api_contract: Extend PUT /cases/{case_id}/plan with separate decision_reference and decision_date; raw legacy text is importer-only audit evidence.
facts.migration_source: SAFE_SPLIT only when a deterministic source parser yields exactly one reference and one date; otherwise BLOCKED_PARSE with raw composite preserved.
invariants: No parser may guess a split.
The composite must not be copied to application or outcome compatibility fields.
unresolved_cases: Multiple candidate references/dates, missing component, or date morphology not proven.
facts.deprecation_plan: Compatibility fields remain read-only historical display only; no new db.ktra writes to them.

facts.business_meaning: Creation date/time of the inspection minutes/report record; never actual inspection timing.
facts.semantic_type: nullable source-faithful date plus nullable raw legacy text
facts.api_contract: Extend PUT /cases/{case_id}/outcome with minutes_recorded_on only; legacy raw evidence is importer-only and cannot be written by runtime clients.
facts.migration_source: SAFE_DIRECT for a proven date; SAFE_SPLIT for a deterministic timestamp/date extraction; BLOCKED_PARSE otherwise.
invariants: Never populate inspected_on or inspected_to_on.
Never use as fallback for Ngày K.tra.
Do not invent a time zone or time-of-day from a date-only value.
unresolved_cases: Timestamp precision or timezone not proven; preserve raw source rather than fabricate precision.
facts.deprecation_plan: bbkt_reference is historical compatibility display only and not a typed timing source.

facts.business_meaning: Ordered inspection-team list: ordinal 1 leader, ordinal 2 secretary, ordinal 3+ member.
facts.semantic_type: ordered structured identities plus immutable legacy display text
facts.api_contract: PUT /cases/{case_id}/team accepts resolved identities and explicit ordered roles; runtime rejects legacy display_text mutation.
facts.migration_source: SAFE_ORDERED_EXPANSION when every source identity resolves exactly; SAFE_DISPLAY_ONLY when any identity is unresolved; BLOCKED_IDENTITY for ambiguous identity matches.
facts.parser_owner: Future parse_legacy_inspection_team adapter plus identity resolver.
invariants: sort_order begins at 1 and is unique per team.
Roles are LEADER at 1, SECRETARY at 2, MEMBER at 3+ when imported from source ordering.
Runtime persists role_label and sort_order.
No Person or InspectorProfile is invented for unresolved text.
unresolved_cases: Unresolvable or ambiguous names remain display-only source evidence.
facts.deprecation_plan: display_text remains read-only legacy evidence, never a runtime editing surrogate.

facts.business_meaning: Repeated PCT approval submissions; a completed PCT does not require CT.
facts.semantic_type: ordered staged submission event with reference, submitted date, status, and optional PCT parent
facts.api_contract: Proposed POST /cases/{case_id}/approval-submissions and stage/status mutation routes, all with row-version concurrency.
facts.migration_source: SAFE_ORDERED_EXPANSION only when source sequence and stage are proven; BLOCKED_PARSE or MANUAL_REVIEW otherwise.
invariants: UNIQUE(case_id, stage, round_no).
PCT has no parent.
A completed PCT does not require CT.
unresolved_cases: Sequence/round correspondence that source cannot prove must not be synthesized.
facts.deprecation_plan: Do not overload CapaCycle; it retains CAPA ownership.

facts.business_meaning: Repeated CT approval submissions after their relevant completed PCT; CT may be absent.
facts.semantic_type: ordered staged submission event with reference, submitted date, status, and required PCT parent
facts.api_contract: Proposed POST /cases/{case_id}/approval-submissions and stage/status mutation routes, all with row-version concurrency.
facts.migration_source: SAFE_ORDERED_EXPANSION only when CT sequence and a completed related PCT are proven; BLOCKED_PARSE or MANUAL_REVIEW otherwise.
invariants: UNIQUE(case_id, stage, round_no).
CT must reference a completed PCT belonging to the same case.
CT cannot precede its related PCT.
unresolved_cases: Sequence/round correspondence that source cannot prove must not be synthesized.
facts.deprecation_plan: Do not overload CapaCycle; it retains CAPA ownership.

facts.business_meaning: Informational deadline/time horizon for a compliance or unscheduled inspection.
facts.api_contract: Extend PUT /cases/{case_id}/outcome with compliance_due_on; expected_version protects concurrent edits.
facts.migration_source: SAFE_DIRECT for an unambiguous source date; BLOCKED_PARSE otherwise.
invariants: INFORMATIONAL_ONLY.
No scheduler, reminder, task generation, workflow transition, overdue state, or inspection creation may consume this field.

facts.business_meaning: Certificate resulting from the inspection row, at most one exact legacy certificate ID.
facts.api_contract: Existing typed certificate issuance/linkage contract; no legacy ID free-form relation endpoint.
compatibility_fields: Certificate.latest_flag and CertificateVersion represent certificate lifecycle/versioning, not legacy-row cardinality.
facts.migration_source: SAFE_LINK only when the exact certificate ID resolves once and case/site/type invariants pass; BLOCKED_IDENTITY otherwise.
invariants: A db.ktra row cannot create a 0..n relation.
Certificate provenance is exact legacy_certificate_id.
Certificate issuance invariants remain enforced by the certificate owner.
unresolved_cases: Missing, duplicate, cross-site, or incompatible certificate identity.
facts.deprecation_plan: No new junction or duplicate certificate owner; retain existing Certificate case relation.

known_contamination: Current importer maps db.ktra.Kết quả to CaseAssessment.assessment_result and InspectionOutcome.outcome_result.
Current importer copies db.ktra.Q. định into CaseApplication.dossier_reference and InspectionOutcome.decision_reference.
Current importer stores db.ktra.B. bản in InspectionOutcome.bbkt_reference; it is not a typed minutes/report timing fact.
non_behavior: No production model, service, route, importer, schema, migration, database, workbook, NAS, or deployment change is made by this design artifact.
